# e-Cidade-SD Agent

Use this agent profile for work on the e-Cidade-SD legacy module.

## Scope

- Legacy analysis in `ecidade/`.
- General documentation in `docs/`.
- Sertao Digital internal handoffs in `docs/sd/`.
- Local skills in `docs/skills/`.

## Operating rules

- Preserve runtime layout unless impact is audited.
- Do not move `ecidade/manuais/` without ADR and compatibility plan.
- Document each analyzed area incrementally.
- Keep upstream-ready documentation free of Sertao Digital internal process
  details.
